instruction: 1 Steam coming-soon next 365d -> 2 exact day and non-sexual -> 3 official Steam Community followers >=5000 -> 4 official localized details and language -> 5 GitHub

provenance.note: Counts are verified from stored repository snapshots; this audit did not independently re-query Steam's full 365-day catalog or Followers. Existing public file left unchanged.

stage2.rule: Steam Store Browse coming_soon_display=date_full; exclude sexual content descriptors 3/4 and strongly explicit adult games

limitations: The snapshot covers 2026-09-19 through 2027-09-18, not a fresh full scan of the shifted 2026-09-20 through 2027-09-19 horizon.
Direct official Steam full-year IStoreQueryService API and Community memberslistxml requests are unavailable in the current tool environment; web-indexed search pages cannot verify all yearly AppIDs.
Existing official Followers values retain their original checked_at timestamps and should not be represented as fresh counts.
An independent exact-day/sexual-content recheck of 3137 entries was not performed in this audit.
